title: Gauge
description: One number against its limit, as an arc — health you can read from across the room.
usage: For a single health metric with a known ceiling: uptime, budget burn, quota. If there is no meaningful limit, a Stat is the honest part instead.
a11y: A chart is a picture of numbers: give the figure role="img" and an aria-label that states the conclusion ("Signups rose from 22 to 71 over the year"), and keep the data available as a table nearby.
